question: Can bounded SOL-aware two-agent product search strengthen the current disjoint forced-conflict lower bounds without assuming goals are absorbing?
method: For each fixed disjoint witness pair, search the static two-agent position graph with vertex/swap conflicts, four-neighbor moves and waits, charging one per agent transition unless both endpoints are its own goal. Aggregate certified pair lower bounds plus unmatched individual BFS distances.
published_inputs: All 20 current accepted archive cases and the 521 disjoint pairs selected by the unchanged tools/headroom.py at this base; no new route/candidate selection.
exposure: All cases are published calibration material. No unseen-transfer or independent-heldout claim.
before_large_run: Price the strongest possible fixed-pair gain using the inherited route's pair costs as upper bounds.
Prove the static product-graph objective and capped-search lower-bound rule, including zero-cost goal holding and allowed departures.
Compare against independent tiny exact search with positive and negative controls.
Run the first 8 existing maze witness pairs as the declared pilot; retain every attempted pair/status/cap.
Freeze the implementation before the 20-case panel; bind its commit/hash in the report.
success: Admissible exact-integer lower bounds that improve at least one current case, or a precise obstruction/counterexample with all attempted pairs and resource accounting. A lower-bound gap is not an achievable route gain.
falsification: Any tiny exact optimum below the reported bound, a bound above the inherited valid witness, an unsound capped-search frontier rule, a goal-departure counterexample, or nonreproducible binding rejects the method.
stopping_and_pivot: No parameter search. If the fixed-pair pilot gives no useful bound gain, one separately recorded pivot may examine pair selection/overlapping pair constraints. Do not silently widen the pair set or caps.
verification: Standalone route checker for inherited upper-bound witnesses; independent exact tiny controls; reproduce all reported pair bounds with frozen code; check disjointness, hashes and sums; existing repository quick/tests; primary-source and proof audit.
authorship: OpenAI Codex gpt-6.1-sol author work, with a research-skill background agent for primary-source reading. Not independent human scientific review.
credit: Predecessor @thakrarsagar headroom ranking/witness audit; project tools/headroom.py, model/checker and archive; established MAPF dependency/weighted-dependency lower bounds; LaCAM3 and Moving AI source notices. Exact paper citations will be recorded in LITERATURE.md.
